title: Reading PACM back
teaches: PACM carries the transport, tempo segments, scenes, controls and every track's key anchors. The meter denominator is display-only and is not on the wire; the wire carries beats-per-bar. Scene-relative keys are stored as absolute tick anchors.
observe: bpm is 120, beatsPerBar is 7 (the 8 in 7/8 is not a wire field), dur is 1441440 ticks and end is hold.
The intro and tail scenes each own half the score.
depth is a targeted slider; sway is an env-only control with target null.
level's scene-local keys become absolute ticks 0/720720 and 720720/1441440.
